lines.en: - This is such a great day.
See, at my house, I got a wife
But this trip, it is the one time a year
I get to pee standing up.
Somebody shot me in the head!
- Oh my God, oh my God, oh my God!
Hold on, hold on, hold on!
Are you in a lot of pain?
- I was shot in the head with a shotgun!
- Ron, it's actually not that serious.
I just need you to stay calm, okay?
- Yeah, I'm just gonna stay angry.
and they're gonna send a ranger.
The rangers won't let us come back next year.
- You know what, we're not gonna think
about that right now, you guys.
Can you just put 'em on the day bed
- Oh my God, someone's over there!
Hey, you know what is great?
Anne's gonna take care of you.
And Anne is the best nurse in North America.
- Did you, did you shoot me?
- There was a bird kinda near me,
and I know how desperate you were to prove yourself.
- No, no, I swear I didn't.
Ron, I swear to God, I've never shot anyone.
- Well, you better find out who it was,
and then purchase them a coffin,
because I'm gonna rip them apart!
- When I look at my palm,
I see a lady's mouth French kissing a dog.
- Well, the pain medication I gave you is pretty strong.
Donny uses it for menstrual cramps.
But I washed them down with plenty of fluids.
- No, Ron, you cannot drink scotch with this.
You're gonna need to purge right now, okay?
- No, I'm not wasting 20 years, scotch.
- Yes, yes. - Can you open his mouth?
- I'm not making myself throw up.
- Oh, Ron, I'm sorry we have to do this.
- Well, good news is Ron is resting comfortably.
- I'll see you next time. - Bye.
